verdict.rationale: Stripe documents importing existing subscriptions from competing billing systems (Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, Chargebee) and offers a no-code Billing migration toolkit. It also describes a multi-step process for migrating customer and payments data, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence of spreadsheet/CSV import, explicit PCI-compliant card data transfer details, evidence that migration is seamless or invisible to customers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
